1.note: Chat SDK createGroupConversation({ users, channelId: order-<id>, channelData.custom: { orderId, listingId } }); App Context memberships; custom is scalar-only

2.note: card in message meta (SDK); meta is immutable, so the live update is a message action of type order_card (the same SDK primitive edits use), added by the server and folded into the card via message.onUpdated

3.note: filter: a Before Publish Function (PubNub's documented path) running our regex; report: message.report (SDK) lands on PUBNUB_INTERNAL_MODERATION_<channel>. Channel Monitor dashboard and Auto Moderation are paid

4.note: no email and no browser push (FCM/APNs only); Events & Actions or Functions to call your own notifier

5.note: no translation feature (a Function could call a translation API, which is the same as building it)

6.note: channel.invite(agentUser) (needs manage in the PAM token, granted); getHistory for earlier messages (25 per call, paginated)

7.note: read receipts: membership.setLastReadMessage + onReadReceiptReceived; typing: startTyping/stopTyping/onTypingChanged; files: MessageDraft.files (5 MB). All SDK features
